newsitem.title: USA: Colorocs sees demise without VCA sale.
newsitem.headline: Colorocs sees demise without VCA sale.

text.p: Colorocs Information Technologies Inc on Friday said it might have to curtail its operations if it fails to sell a majority-owned subsidiary to a California company.

"If the company is unable to obtain adequate additional funding or timely complete the sale of VCA, management may be required to curtail the company's operations," it said, referring to the subsidiary, ViewCall America Inc.

"Future prospects and the ongoing health of the company are largely dependent on the completion of the sale of VCA to NetChannel," it said. "(It also depends on the) success of the company in selling additional patent licenses or the receipt of additional financing, none of which can be assured."
Colorocs has agreed in principle to sell VCA to NetChannel Inc.
It also reported a loss of $3.51 a share for 1996 against a profit of $1.08 for the previous year, saying the loss mainly reflected investments it had made to establish VCA's operations.
The subsidiary is developing an Internet television channel called On-TV.
